content.text:
I submitted index 14 (Sb 0.236 / Y 0.764) as the best composition. It had the highest EQE of the three I measured, about 2.7×10⁻⁴ %, but I can't tell it apart from the other two: all three readings are at the noise floor.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 28 | 0.666 | 1.35×10⁻⁴ |
| 14 | 0.236 | 2.7×10⁻⁴ |
| 9 | 0.136 | −8.3×10⁻⁵ |

- **Why so low:** Sb and Y oxides are both wide-gap materials, so I didn't expect much response under 2.7 eV light. The results fit that.
- **What I tried:** the merit budget was only 3 measurements. I took one near the Sb-rich end (28), one in the middle (14), then followed the Gaussian-process suggestion to Y-rich index 9, which read slightly negative.
- **Not checked:** I used none of the 5 XRD measurements. The 26 unmeasured compositions weren't tested, so a better one could be among them.
